html:
The Totoró are an Indigenous people of the Cauca department in southwestern Colombia, in the Andes east of Popayán. Tontotuna is their own name for their land.

Their language, Namtrik, belongs to the Barbacoan family and is close to that of the Misak, their neighbours to the south. The Nasa live nearby. Under Spanish rule they kept communal land as a resguardo. In the 1970s they joined the Cauca Indigenous movement to win back land from haciendas. Few Totoró still speak Namtrik.
